text: 8月5日，人民银行上海总部组织召开上海市金融形势分析会，学习传达近期人民银行、外汇局有关会议精神，分析当前经济金融形势，部署做好下半年金融服务上海经济高质量发展相关工作。
text_en: On August 5, the PBOC Shanghai Head Office convened a Shanghai financial situation analysis meeting to study and convey recent meeting spirits of the PBOC and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, analyze current economic and financial conditions, and deploy work to better support high-quality development of Shanghai's economy through financial services in H2.
